decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The portakabins shall be used as offices ancillary to the use of the land as a highways depot, and shall only be used for work on trunk roads and motorways in the London West region, and for no other purposes

Condition : 3 - When the premises cease to be used as offices ancillary to the use of the land as a highways depot serving trunk road and motorways in the London West region, or at the end of 3 years, whichever shall first occur, the use hereby permitted shall cease, the portakabins shall be removed from the site and the land restored to its former condition
description: Installation of portable buildings for use as office with associatedtoilet facilities.
